summary.background: The increasing trend prior to and after 1998 was 2.5×10SUP‐3/SUP yearSUP‐1/SUP and 0.9×10SUP‐3/SUP yearSUP‐1/SUP, respectively.
summary.method: In this study, the Global Inventory Modeling and Mapping Studies (GIMMS) based Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) and CRU climate data are used to analyze the spatio‐temporal characteristics of vegetation greening evolution and its response to climate change from 1982 to 2015 in the Korean Peninsula by applying the partial correlation and trend analysis.
